title: Custom Skid-Mounted Process Equipment Fabrication & Assembly Project
summary:
This project reference highlights TONGYANG's involvement in the fabrication and assembly of customized skid-mounted process equipment for industrial applications.

The equipment shown includes stainless steel process vessels, external heating or cooling coil arrangements, flanged connections, and heavy-duty structural support frames.

Horizontal and vertical equipment configurations demonstrate the flexibility of customized manufacturing for different process and installation requirements.
body:
TONGYANG's Involvement

Yangzhou Tongyang Chemical Equipment Co., Ltd. supported equipment-related manufacturing activities, including:

  • Customized process vessel fabrication

  • External coil and vessel component manufacturing

  • Structural steel frame fabrication and assembly

  • Mechanical interface and installation coordination

  • Manufacturing quality control according to project requirements

Project Highlights

Customized Equipment Configuration

Vessel dimensions, connections, support structures, and equipment arrangements can be adapted to specific process requirements.

Integrated Structural Design

Steel frames and supporting platforms facilitate equipment positioning, installation planning, and maintenance access.

Modular Manufacturing Approach

Prefabricated equipment assemblies help simplify subsequent transportation and on-site integration.

Project Significance

This manufacturing reference demonstrates TONGYANG's capabilities in custom process equipment fabrication, structural integration, and equipment assembly for chemical and industrial processing applications.

Equipment specifications, operating conditions, and applicable design standards are determined by individual project requirements.
seoDescription: Explore TONGYANG's skid-mounted process equipment fabrication, featuring stainless steel vessels, external coils, and integrated structural frames.
